title: Spawn with --no-wait, require Paseo 0.12.0 everywhere, steer through paseo send
action:
A. Run flag, per D1 (store 5477c172). In herding/paseo.rs `run_argv`, replace the token `"-d".to_string(),` (second element of the initial argv vec, right after `"run".to_string(),`) with `"--no-wait".to_string(),`. Update the three run_argv unit tests that pin it — `rg -n '"-d",' packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/paseo.rs` hits `1239:                "-d",`, `1268:                "-d",`, `1306:                "-d",` — to expect `"--no-wait",`. B. Steer argv, per D3 (store ad803822) and D6 (store 11719b08). Directly below `send_argv` in paseo.rs add `pub fn send_steer_argv(id: &str, text: &str) -> Vec<String>` returning exactly [send, <id>, --behavior, steer, --no-wait, --, <text>] and add that shape to the existing `new_argv_builders_produce_expected_tokens` test. C. Version floor, per D2 (store 4236f83d) and D5 (store 5ccde9fb): every Paseo floor becomes 0.12.0. doctor.rs: the tuple at `} else if !crate::herding::paseo::version_at_least(&out, (0, 10, 3)) {` becomes (0, 12, 0); the two `upgrade to 0.10.3 with npm @getpaseo/cli` FIX strings and the ok detail `version >= 0.10.3` say 0.12.0. herding/run.rs: both `Ok(out) => paseo::version_at_least(&out, (0, 10, 3)),` sites (near the spawn and the continue path) become (0, 12, 0); the refusal strings `paseo version 0.10.3 or newer required — FIX: install or update paseo (npm @getpaseo/cli 0.10.3+)` (two sites) and `start the daemon with paseo daemon start (npm @getpaseo/cli 0.10.3+)` say 0.12.0. Tests: in run.rs the ~42 fixtures `Ok("0.10.3
")` become `Ok("0.12.0
")` (one bulk replace) and the asserts `assert!(msg.contains("0.10.3"));` (two sites) and `...(npm @getpaseo/cli 0.10.3+)"))` say 0.12.0; in doctor/tests.rs every `version_out: Ok("0.10.3"...)` fixture (13 sites, including the AppImage string `[desktop] app startup { version: '0.10.3' }
0.10.3`) becomes 0.12.0, the old-version fixture `version_out: Ok("0.10.2".to_string()),` becomes 0.11.4, and the two `.contains("upgrade to 0.10.3 with npm @getpaseo/cli")` asserts say 0.12.0. Afterwards `rg -n '0\.10\.3' packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/doctor.rs packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/run.rs packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/doctor/tests.rs` must print nothing (paseo.rs's own `version_at_least_checks_semver` test may keep its 0.10.3 sample strings). D. Steer verb, per D3, D4 (store dc38fecc) and D7 (store 87defaa3). In herding/job_verbs.rs change `steer_job_with` to take `paseo_cli: Option<&dyn crate::herding::paseo::PaseoCli>` instead of `runner: &dyn crate::herding::paseo_steer::SteerRunner`; `steer_job` (hit `steer_job_with(main_root, job_id, text, &crate::herding::paseo_steer::RealSteerRunner)`) passes None. Inside the `is_paseo` branch keep the two `paseo_steer_unsupported` refusals (unreadable or missing paseo config) and the `paseo_steer_failed` refusal for a missing `paseo_agent_id`; delete the `if spec.provider != "pi"` split, the `steerable` check (hit `if !crate::herding::paseo_steer::steerable(&spec.provider) {`), the `cli_package_dir` lookup and the `runner.steer(...)` call. In their place, for EVERY provider: resolve the CLI lazily exactly as `interrupt` does (hit `real_cli = crate::herding::paseo::RealPaseoCli::new(cmd).with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5));` — `Some(c)` uses it, `None` builds from `crate::herding::paseo::paseo_command(&cfg)` with a 5 s timeout, `cfg` is already read in this branch), call `cli.call(&crate::herding::paseo::send_steer_argv(paseo_agent_id, text))`, map Err to code `paseo_steer_failed` with message `herding steer: paseo steer failed: {e}. FIX: check the Paseo daemon`, and `return Ok(next_n)` — a Paseo job never writes the mailbox steer file. The non-Paseo path (the `steer_obj` / `steer-{next_n}.json` write) stays byte-for-byte. Delete `packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/paseo_steer.rs` and `paseo_steer.mjs`, and remove `pub(crate) mod paseo_steer;` from herding.rs. Tests in job_verbs.rs: delete `FakeSteerRunner` and `setup_fake_cli` (hits `struct FakeSteerRunner {`, `impl crate::herding::paseo_steer::SteerRunner for FakeSteerRunner {`, `fn setup_fake_cli(tmp: &Path)`); reuse the in-file `FakePaseoCli` (hit `struct FakePaseoCli {`, with `calls` and a settable `result`) and rewrite the four steer tests (`steer_job_with_fake_runner_for_claude`, `steer_job_with_fake_runner_for_pi`, `steer_job_with_unknown_provider`, `steer_job_with_runner_error`) into: a pi Paseo job and a claude Paseo job each make exactly one call equal to `send_steer_argv(agent_id, text)` and write no `steer-1.json`; a provider name bee has never seen (e.g. `omp`) makes the same single call (no allow-list); a failing CLI yields `paseo_steer_failed` with `FIX: check the Paseo daemon`; a job whose agent has no paseo config yields `paseo_steer_unsupported` (new case — today no test covers it). `steer_writes_text_verbatim_as_numbered_files` in herding/tests.rs (non-Paseo job) stays green; adjust only its call site if the signature forces it. Afterwards `rg -n 'paseo_steer::|mod paseo_steer|paseo_steer\.(rs|mjs)' packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src` must print nothing (the error codes paseo_steer_failed / paseo_steer_unsupported stay). No code comments anywhere.
